## Make cell meta data table

# Cell metadata export

```{r}
anno = c("1"              = "1. Fibroblasts",
         "2"              = "2. Mesonephric cells",
         "3"              = "3. Migrating erythrocytes",
         "4"              = "4. Granulosa cells",
         "5"              = "5. PGCs/oogonia/oocytes",
         "6"              = "6. Endothelial cells",
         "7"              = "7. Podocytes",
         "8"              = "8. Erythrocytes",
         "9"              = "9. Migrating pre-granulosa cells",
         "10"             = "10. Hemopoietic stem cells",
         "11"             = "11. Migrating leukocytes",
         "12_transformer" = "12T. Bipotential gonadal supporting cells",
         "12_larva"       = "12L. Mitotic macrophages",
         "13"             = "13. Macrophages",
         "14"             = "14. Migrating/mitotic pre-granulosa cells",
         "15"             = "15. Mitotic spermatogonia",
         "16"             = "16. Spermatocytes I",
         "17"             = "17. Spermatocytes II",
         "18"             = "18. Migrating spermatocytes")

# load the all-cells merged object for the full metadata join
all_clusters = 
  read.csv(paste0(params$project_dir, "/results/20260813_atlas/cell_cluster_labels.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell_type = unname(anno[as.character(final_label)])) %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, final_label, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::rename(cluster = "final_label")

all.sce  = readRDS(paste0(altas_results_dir, "/all.sce.Rds"))

cell_meta = dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(all.sce, function(x)
  as.data.frame(colData(x)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::where(~ inherits(.x, "outlier.filter")),
                                as.logical)))) %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, sum, detected, subsets_Mito_percent) %>%
  left_join(all_clusters, by = "barcode")

merged.sce  = readRDS(paste0(altas_results_dir, "/merged.sce.Rds"))  

all_tsne      = reducedDim(merged.sce, "TSNE")
all_corrected = reducedDim(merged.sce, "corrected")
colnames(all_corrected) = paste0("fastMNN.corrected.", 1:50)

cell_meta$TSNE1 = all_tsne[, "TSNE1"]
cell_meta$TSNE2 = all_tsne[, "TSNE2"]
cell_meta = cbind(cell_meta, all_corrected)

germ_corrected = as.data.frame(reducedDim(lineage_ob$corrected, "corrected"))
colnames(germ_corrected) = paste0("germ.fastMNN.corrected.", 1:50)
germ_corrected$barcode = rownames(germ_corrected)

germ_meta = 
  left_join(germ_pseudotime, germ_corrected, by = "barcode") %>%
  select(-cluster, -annotation, -library, -stage)

meta_final =
  cell_meta %>%
  dplyr::left_join(germ_meta, by = "barcode", relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
  rename(trajectory.node = "node")

write.table(meta_final,
            file      = paste0(altas_results_dir, "/cell_metadata.tsv"),
            row.names = FALSE,
            sep       = "\t",
            quote     = FALSE)

zip(zipfile = paste0(altas_results_dir, "/cell_metadata.tsv.gz"),
    files   = paste0(altas_results_dir, "/cell_metadata.tsv"))
```

### Add meta data

```{r}
# set coldata
rownames(cell_meta) = cell_meta$barcode
cell_meta_ordered <- cell_meta[colnames(combined.sce), , drop = FALSE]
colData(combined.sce) <- DataFrame(cell_meta_ordered)

# set rowdata
rownames(gene_descriptions) = gene_descriptions$Gene
gene_descriptions_ordered = gene_descriptions[rownames(combined.sce), , drop = FALSE]
rowData(combined.sce) = DataFrame(gene_descriptions_ordered)
```

### Set cluster annotations and pallettes

All cells
```{r}
anno = c("1"              = "1. Fibroblasts",
         "2"              = "2. Mesonephric cells",
         "3"              = "3. Migrating erythrocytes",
         "4"              = "4. Granulosa cells",
         "5"              = "5. PGCs/oogonia/oocytes",
         "6"              = "6. Endothelial cells",
         "7"              = "7. Podocytes",
         "8"              = "8. Erythrocytes",
         "9"              = "9. Migrating pre-granulosa cells",
         "10"             = "10. Hemopoietic stem cells",
         "11"             = "11. Migrating leukocytes",
         "12_transformer" = "12T. Bipotential gonadal supporting cells",
         "12_larva"       = "12L. Mitotic macrophages",
         "13"             = "13. Macrophages",
         "14"             = "14. Migrating/mitotic pre-granulosa cells",
         "15"             = "15. Mitotic spermatogonia",
         "16"             = "16. Spermatocytes I",
         "17"             = "17. Spermatocytes II",
         "18"             = "18. Migrating spermatocytes")


level_order = 1:19
combined.sce$cluster <- factor(combined.sce$cluster, levels = level_order)

anno_order = 
  c("1. Fibroblasts", 
    "2. Mesonephric cells", 
    "3. Migrating erythrocytes", 
    "4. Granulosa cells", 
    "5. PGCs/oogonia/oocytes", 
    "6. Endothelial cells", 
    "7. Podocytes", 
    "8. Erythrocytes", 
    "9. Migrating pre-granulosa cells", 
    "10. Hemopoietic stem cells", 
    "11. Migrating leukocytes", 
    "12. Mitotic macrophages", 
    "13. Macrophages", 
    "14. Migrating/mitotic pre-granulosa cells", 
    "15. Mitotic spermatogonia", 
    "16. Spermatocytes I", 
    "17. Spermatocytes II", 
    "18. Migrating spermatocytes")

combined.sce$CellType <- anno_order[as.integer(as.character(combined.sce$cluster))]

all_label_colors <- c("#1F77B4", "#AEC7E8", "#FF7F0E", "#FFBB78",
                      "#2CA02C", "#98DF8A", "#D62728", "#FF9896",
                      "#9467BD", "#C5B0D5", "#8C564B", "#C49C94",
                      "#E377C2", "#F7B6D2", "#7F7F7F", "#C7C7C7",
                      "#BCBD22", "#DBDB8D", "#17BECF")
publication_palette <- setNames(all_label_colors, anno_order)
```

### Fig.1: All cell tSNE

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
level_order = 1:19
cell_meta$cluster = factor(cell_meta$cluster, levels = level_order)

cell_meta <- cell_meta %>%
  mutate(CellType = anno_order[as.integer(cluster)])

p_fig1 <- plot_tsne(df           = cell_meta,
                    color_col    = "CellType",
                    label_col    = "cluster",
                    palette      = publication_palette,
                    color_levels = anno_order,
                    point_size   = 0.5,
                    text_color   = "black",
                    bg_color     = "white",
                    text_size    = 2) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        legend.key       = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))

p_fig1
ggsave(paste0(results_dir, "/Fig1_tsne.png"), width = 8, height = 5)
```

```{r, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=8}
id_oi = c("LOC116957683",

  gene_descriptions %>%
  filter(Gene %in% id_oi) %>%
  pull(WangGeneID)

plot_violin_goi(sce              = combined.sce,
                markers          = scatter_markers,
                goi              = goi,
                gene_description = gene_descriptions,
                anno             = anno_order,
                palette          = publication_palette,
                label_col        = "label",
                level_order      = 1:19,
                title            = NULL,
                ncol             = 2)

```
